figurative_meaning_en: fault of the ancestors or family lineage
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার এই অভ্যাস ঝাড়ের দোষ, তার বংশের চলে আসা।
এই সমস্যা ঝাড়ের দোষে হয়েছে, পূর্বপুরুষদের কৃতকর্মের ফল।
example_sentences_in_english: His bad habit is the fault of the storm, inherited from his family lineage.
This problem stems from the fault of the storm, the result of ancestors' deeds.
note: This idiom metaphorically attributes personal flaws to ancestral origins, common in traditional Bengali storytelling.
